Thanks Ben — attaching our redlined MSA. Quick notes up-front: we can agree to a three-year term, but we need the following clarified in the MSA and the order form before procurement will sign:

- Section 6.2 (Data retention): change to 13 months with explicit deletion timelines for test datasets.
- Section 9 (Liability): carve out language around third-party model dependencies — we want cap clarified.
- Add a specific SLA for model-availability during scheduled maintenance windows.

Attachment: Novus_MSA_redline_2028.docx (docx)

Procurement is aiming to finish review by Feb 15 if Redwood can turn around legal responses quickly. Also note we need firm pricing for the ramp — Tony will share the expected start date and monthly usage ramp.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Feb 2028 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal: term extension + compute uplift — MSA redline coordination

Ben / Monica — I reviewed Novus's redlines and drafted proposed language. Key points: 

1) Data retention (Sec 6.2): agree to 13 months for customer-created datasets; proposed clause adds clear deletion timeline (30 days after termination for non-essential test data).
2) Liability (Sec 9): we will accept a clarified cap of liability tied to the total fees paid in the prior 12 months, with carve-outs for gross negligence and breach of confidentiality. I added a sentence limiting third-party model dependency liability to commercially reasonable efforts.
3) SLA: added a maintenance-window notification requirement and a 99.5% availability target for model-serving endpoints, with service credit formula for breaches.

I attached the response with tracked changes: Redwood_MSA_response_20280205.docx. Please review — I flagged a couple of negotiation points for sales to approve (liability cap level and SLA credits).

Recommended next step: Ben, propose a one-hour call with Novus procurement to walk the compromise language on 02/08 or 02/09. I can join if legal is needed.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_MSA_response_20280205.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda@novushealth.com>, Tony Rivera <tony.rivera@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Feb 2028 14:43:00 -0800
Subject: Finalizing Novus renewal package — next steps and timeline

Amanda / Tony / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for prioritizing this. Per Lauren's proposed language and our internal approvals, here's what we agreed on: 

- Term: 36 months, effective on PO date.
- Capacity: 2x baseline GPU hours for first 12 months, with defined monthly ramp in the attached order form.
- Pricing: annual price bands with a 4% step-down in year 2 and year 3 after ramp completion (see OrderForm_CapacityUplift_v2.pdf).
- MSA: Data retention set to 13 months with 30-day deletion for test artifacts; liability cap = fees paid in prior 12 months; SLA = 99.5% with defined credits.

Next steps:
1) Novus procurement to issue PO referencing Deal ID DEAL-4857-NOVUS.
2) I'll upload the final order form to DocuSign and share the link once PO is received.
3) Monica will schedule a capacity cutover window after the PO / DocuSign signature.

Target dates: PO by 02/15 -> DocuSign by 02/16 -> cutover week starting 03/01. If procurement needs an expedited lane, please flag.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0147
